new_scholarship.description: Supports researchers of all nationalities and research areas to conduct their own research in Germany in collaboration with a host at a research institution of their choice, as part of the Global Minds Initiative Germany of the Federal Ministry of Research, Technology and Space. The monthly fellowship amount is 3,000 euros for postdocs and 3,600 euros for experienced researchers, each plus additional benefits, for stays of 6 to 24 and 6 to 18 months respectively. Applications are made in three annual calls, each opening on 15 March, 15 July or 15 November and closing once it reaches the current maximum of 800 applications.

research_notes.logo: The logo is served by the awarding body's own page header: the Australia Awards Scholarships page renders an img at https://www.dfat.gov.au/themes/custom/dfat/logo.png, 814 by 140 pixels. It was probed by fetching the bytes inside the page context and returned HTTP 200 with content type image/png and 21,863 bytes; decoding it on a canvas showed the dominant opaque colour as the near-black RGB 31,25,26 (#1F191A) with 12,270 opaque pixels over transparent, i.e. a dark department wordmark and coat of arms that is clearly visible on a light card and is not white-on-transparent. Direct downloads from dfat.gov.au are blocked from this environment's network, which is why the probe was run in the page context; the reported status and content type come from the fetch response itself. The record had no stored image.
